question: Read Figure 2.10 from the poorest to the richest household decile. How do the family-farm and family-business shares of household income change? Refer to both legend colors.
answer: From the poorest decile (1) to the richest decile (10) in Figure 2.10, the family-farm share of household income, represented by the green legend color, decreases from approximately 34 percent to about 8 percent. Meanwhile, the family-business share, represented by the orange legend color, increases from roughly 5 percent to about 32 percent. [p081-figure-2.10]
